items.title: Plane hit by firework while landing in Chicago
items.excerpt: The plane had 52 passengers and six crew onboard. No injuries were reported.

items.title: The Main Attraction at Africa’s Most Lucrative Horse Race? Black Wealth.
items.excerpt: In South Africa, where the Black majority was excluded from the economy for generations, the annual Durban July event is a chance to celebrate luxury and high society.

items.title: Iran's supreme leader absent as senior officials attend ayatollah's funeral
items.excerpt: Mojtaba Khamenei has not been seen in public since the attack which killed his father at the outset of the US-Israel war with Iran.

items.title: Exhausted by Iran War, Tehran Transforms for Khamenei’s Funeral
items.excerpt: Throughout the capital, the government is using Ayatollah Ali Khamenei’s funeral to project strength at a time of great uncertainty for Iran.

items.title: Emotion and politics merge in Tehran at funeral of former supreme leader
items.excerpt: The BBC's chief international correspondent Lyse Doucet is in Tehran, where funeral events are taking place in honour of Iran's former leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

items.title: China Raises Pressure on Taiwan With Expanded Coast Guard Patrols
items.excerpt: Beijing sent two ships to patrol the waters east of Taiwan, a new campaign to challenge the island’s control of waters crucial to any future invasion.

items.title: From the Archives: Kurt Vonnegut Jr. on Robert Altman’s ‘Nashville,’ the Bicentennial, and America
items.excerpt: “Nashville—a shadow play of what we have become and where we might look for wisdom,” by Kurt Vonnegut Jr., was published in the June 1975 issue of Vogue.

items.title: Nigeria says two nationals killed in South Africa amid rise of anti-migrant attacks
items.excerpt: Nigeria's government said one of its nationals was reportedly killed by police officers "using gruesome interrogation techniques".

items.title: Guam and Northern Mariana Islands Prepare for Typhoon Bavi
items.excerpt: Typhoon Bavi, a tropical cyclone barreling through the Pacific Ocean, was forecast to pass near the U.S. territories on Monday with the force of a Category 5 hurricane.
